title: Pakistani ex-PM Imran Khan moved back to jail after medical checkup
summary: RT reports that former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan was taken under heavy security to an Islamabad hospital for a medical checkup in the early hours of Friday, in compliance with a Supreme Court directive. According to RT, he was quickly returned to jail after the examination. The report does not provide further details on the reasons behind the court's order or Khan's current legal situation.

title: Ex-Pakistan PM Khan taken back to jail after hospital checks
summary: According to a report from Biztoc.com, former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan was returned to jail on Friday following a brief hospital visit for medical checks mandated by the Supreme Court. The court had ordered earlier in the week that the 73-year-old politician undergo the examination, reflecting ongoing judicial oversight of his detention conditions. The report does not provide further detail on the outcome of the medical checks or the status of his underlying legal cases.

title: Ex-Pakistan PM Khan returned to jail after hospital checks
summary: According to The Punch, former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan was taken back to Adiala Jail following medical examinations that a court had ordered. The visit to the hospital drew criticism from Khan's political party, which took issue with how the process was managed. Khan remains incarcerated as legal proceedings against him continue.

summary: Al Jazeera English reports that Pakistan's PTI party has accused the government of failing to comply with a court order directing that former Prime Minister Imran Khan be taken to a hospital. According to the report, Khan's sister and his personal physician recounted a confusing and tense night, during which officials reportedly gave inconsistent statements about his location. title: Former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan back in jail after hospital visit
summary: According to The Irish Times, former Pakistani prime minister Imran Khan has returned to jail following a hospital visit that was mandated by the Supreme Court. The court had ordered authorities to transfer Khan to a hospital, though the specific medical or legal reasons behind this order were not detailed. Khan has since been moved back into custody after receiving the hospital treatment.

title: Former Pakistan PM Khan said to be taken to hospital
summary: According to Biztoc.com, imprisoned former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan has reportedly been moved to Shifa International Hospital for a medical evaluation. The transfer is said to have followed a directive issued by the Supreme Court, though further details on his condition or the case background were not provided.

title: Jailed former Pakistan PM Imran Khan moved to Islamabad hospital after Supreme Court order
summary: According to The Times of India, jailed former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan has been shifted to a hospital in Islamabad following a directive from the Supreme Court. The move comes after his party had long been demanding his transfer, citing a serious decline in his health during his ongoing imprisonment. The report indicates the judiciary intervened to address concerns raised over his medical condition while in custody.

title: Pakistan's ex-PM Imran Khan moved to hospital following court order
summary: According to Business Standard, Pakistan's Supreme Court has directed that former Prime Minister Imran Khan, 73, be shifted to Shifa International Hospital in Islamabad for medical treatment. The court order reportedly comes amid concerns over Khan's health, which includes an eye condition among other ailments.

title: Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan taken back to prison from hospital, party spokesman says
summary: According to CNA, former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan has been returned to prison following a hospital visit, as confirmed by a spokesman for his party. Khan has remained incarcerated since August 2023, maintaining that the legal cases brought against him are politically driven, a claim the government rejects.

title: Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan taken back to prison from hospital, party spokesman says
summary: According to a report from Biztoc.com, former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan was briefly taken to a hospital in Islamabad early Friday for a medical examination before being returned to prison the same day. A spokesman for his party confirmed the overnight hospital visit, though further details about his health or the reason for the examination were not specified. Khan, 73, remains in custody amid his ongoing legal troubles.

title: Former Pakistan PM Imran Khan taken back to Adiala Jail after medical evaluation
summary: According to The Times of India, former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan was taken back to Adiala Jail following a medical evaluation at Shifa International Hospital in Islamabad. The transfer was carried out under strict security protocols mandated by the Supreme Court, as Khan continues serving his sentence.

title: Pak ex-PM Imran Khan sent back to jail after SC-ordered hospital checkup
summary: According to Business Standard, former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan was returned to jail after undergoing a medical checkup at Shifa International Hospital. The hospital visit came after Pakistan's Supreme Court had directed authorities to have Khan examined for his reported health issues. Khan was taken to the facility early Friday before being sent back into custody.

title: Move Imran Khan to hospital, Pakistan's Supreme Court says amid concerns over ex-PM's health
summary: According to ThePrint, Pakistan's Supreme Court has directed authorities to shift former Prime Minister Imran Khan to a hospital amid growing concerns over his health while in custody. The court also flagged the harsh restrictions and isolation faced by political prisoners in the country, and ordered that Khan be allowed weekly meetings with his family members.

title: Pakistan government to challenge Imran Khan hospital move, says law minister
summary: According to The Times of India, Pakistan's government plans to contest a Supreme Court ruling that directed former Prime Minister Imran Khan's transfer to a private hospital in Islamabad within two days. The order reportedly came after Khan's party and family raised concerns over his healthcare access and visitation rights. The country's law minister confirmed the government's intention to challenge this judicial directive.

title: Pakistan government to challenge ex-PM Khan hospital move
summary: DW (English) reports that Pakistan's government intends to challenge a Supreme Court order directing that jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan be transferred to a private hospital. The court had issued the order following concerns raised about Khan's worsening health while in custody. Authorities are now seeking to have that ruling reviewed.

title: Pakistan govt to fight court order moving jailed Imran Khan to hospital
summary: According to Business Standard, Pakistan's government intends to challenge a court order directing that jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan be moved to a hospital for treatment. Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar stated that Khan should instead be treated at a state-run facility, contending that prison regulations do not permit inmates to receive care at private hospitals. The dispute sets up a legal fight over the terms of Khan's medical treatment while in custody.

title: Pakistan top court orders Imran Khan’s hospital transfer amid access battle
summary: Pakistan's Supreme Court has ordered the transfer of jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan to a hospital for a one-month period, according to Al Jazeera English. The decision follows concerns raised about his blood pressure and comes amid an ongoing dispute over access to the imprisoned ex-leader. The ruling appears to address health-related issues alongside broader questions about visitation and communication with Khan while he remains in custody.

title: Pakistan court orders ex-PM Imran Khan be moved to hospital from jail
summary: A Pakistani court has directed that former Prime Minister Imran Khan be transferred from jail to a hospital, according to BBC News. Khan has been in custody since 2023 on corruption-related charges, which he maintains were brought against him for political reasons. The report does not provide further details on Khan's current health or the specific reasoning behind the court's order.

title: Court orders Pakistan’s jailed ex-PM Imran Khan to be moved to hospital
summary: According to RT, Pakistan's Supreme Court has directed that jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan be transferred to a hospital. The order follows concerns raised by Khan's family and his Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf party regarding his health, which they attribute to prolonged isolation in prison. The court's ruling addresses the welfare issues cited by the former cricketer-turned-politician's supporters.

title: Pakistan top court orders ex-PM Imran Khan be moved to hospital from jail
summary: According to BBC News, Pakistan's top court has directed that former Prime Minister Imran Khan be transferred from prison to a hospital. Khan has been jailed since 2023 on corruption charges, which he maintains were politically motivated. The order marks a notable development in the legal proceedings surrounding his imprisonment.

title: Imran Khan’s sister meets him after 9 months as Pakistan SC orders hospital transfer for jailed ex-PM
summary: According to The Times of India, Imran Khan's sister Noreen Niazi was able to meet him at Adiala Jail after a nine-month gap, following a Pakistan Supreme Court order mandating weekly family visits and his transfer to a hospital. The former prime minister also had a longer meeting with his wife, Bushra Bibi, amid medical reports citing fluctuations in his blood-related health parameters. The court's intervention appears aimed at addressing concerns over his health and access to family during his continued incarceration.
